newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Cargolux to sell one Boeing 747-200.
newsitem.headline: Cargolux to sell one Boeing 747-200.

text.p: Cargolux said it would be putting one of its Boeing 747-200 freighters up for sale following a decision on the future size of its fleet.
Earlier this year, the Luxembourg-based all-cargo airline decided to invest in two, additional Boeing 747-400Fs during the second half of 1997, as opposed to one, as was initially planned.
Cargolux currently operates three 747-400Fs and four 747-200Fs, one of which is on leaseback from Colorado-based Atlas Air Inc.

"Our future fleet will comprise seven Cargloux-owned aircraft, made up of five 400Fs and two 200Fs, and possibly one 200F on leaseback. Of course, the option of leasing additional aircraft would be there if market demand warranted it " said Pierre Wesner, Cargolux' vice-president, Sales and Marketing Europe/Africa/Middle East.
He added: "Operating an all-400F fleet becomes a realistic possibility now although no time-scale had been fixed to achieve this."

The 200F set to quit the fleet would probably be put up for sale once Cargolux had taken delivery of its fourth and fifth 400F later this year, Wesner said. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel:44-171-542-7706 Fax 5017
